reply.speaker: Ponticius
reply.text:
*The Guild Master lets out a short, gruff laugh, though there's no real mirth in it. He crosses his arms, the scarred leather of his vambraces creaking as he shifts his weight.*
"Right enough. Back the way you came. Arin's got the eye for the trail, and he's and he knows these parts well enough."
*He gestures toward the door with a chin-flick, not bothering withs a formal dismissal. His expression has hardened, the kind of look he gives when sending folk off on a dangerous mission.*
"Make it quick, make it smart. The weather's turning and those rivers are running high with runoff. Don't go gettin' caught in the current."
*His eyes linger on you for a moment longer than necessary, as if measuring whether you've got the sense to avoid a drowning pool.* "Head on."

reply.text:
*Luke follows along, trying to match the pace, but his chainmail is making a lot of noise. He keeps glancing at Max and Arin, his excitement still palpable.*
*He clears his throat, the sound a bit loud in the quiet.*
"So, um, you-you're really going on a lot of quests, right?"
*He looks at Max with a wide-eyed stare, as if expecting an answer.*
"I mean, you must've seen some pretty incredible things, right?"
*His voice is fast and quiet, but his eagerness is clear. He's practically buzzing with energy.*
